intent: Archive the billsplit Flutter app to testsAndMisc-archive together with everything coupled to it, so the monorepo's 100% coverage gate and binary-allowlist stay consistent.
scope: python_pkg/billsplit_coverage/ (5 files) - removed, its only purpose was gating billsplit
Non-goal: app_icons itself stays; only its billsplit entry goes
changes: Extracted billsplit/ and python_pkg/billsplit_coverage/ in one filter-repo pass (8 commits, matching the monorepo's count for those paths) and merged into kuhyx/testsAndMisc-archive, where billsplit_coverage joins the existing python_pkg/ tree.

Deleted the app_icons AppIcon entry keyed 'billsplit', whose repo= pointed at _HOME/testsAndMisc/billsplit. app_icons stays in the repo and its tests iterate APPS generically, so a dangling entry would have failed the suite.
Emptied .binary-allowlist: billsplit's launcher icons were its only entries. The policy header is kept and now records that no exception is in force.
Removed the 27-line billsplit block from .gitignore (the ! overrides that paired with the allowlist) and the .prettierignore fixture line.

Rewrote the AGENTS.md 'Adding a Flutter app' section: the both-halves guidance is still correct for a future app, but no longer claims billsplit exists, and notes a Flutter app now belongs in its own repo.

verification.command: git ls-files <path> | wc -l, archive vs source
verification.evidence: billsplit 73 = 73, python_pkg/billsplit_coverage 5 = 5; 8 commits, equal to git log --oneline -- billsplit python_pkg/billsplit_coverage.

verification.command: diff -r --brief between archived copy and working tree
verification.evidence: No content differences for either path.
billsplit listed; billsplit_coverage confirmed under the archive's python_pkg/ alongside the previously archived packages.
2095 passed, TOTAL coverage 100.00% - the gate holds after removing the registry entry. Count fell from 2114 by exactly the 19 billsplit_coverage tests.
Registry loads with 12 apps and 'billsplit' in apps.APPS is False. Seven other apps still carry linux=False, so no cli.py branch lost its only exercise.
Exit 0 with an entry-free .binary-allowlist - the checker tolerates a comment-only file.

risks: app_icons' generator can no longer produce billsplit's icons; that is intended, since the app and its assets now live in the archive.
.binary-allowlist is now empty of patterns. If a future Flutter app is added, both it and the .gitignore ! overrides must be repopulated - AGENTS.md still documents that requirement.
The archive push happened before the local delete; presence was confirmed through the GitHub API rather than assumed.
rollback: git revert the removal commit to restore all four trees and the config blocks.
Re-run meta/scripts/pytest_changed_packages.py to confirm the coverage gate is still satisfied after the revert.
